summary: Calculate and publish daily Growing Degree Days
description: Loads daily minimum and maximum temperature collections over the same time interval and area, calculates daily GDD as max(0, ((Tmin + Tmax) / 2) - Tbase), and publishes the result to the selected registered output dataset. Use the forecast temperature collections with gdd_forecast_daily, or the ENACTS historical collections with gdd_historical_daily. Both input collections must share matching time and spatial coordinates.

parameters.name: tmin_dataset_id
parameters.description: Daily minimum-temperature collection, e.g. tmin_forecast_daily or enacts_tmin_daily.

parameters.name: tmax_dataset_id
parameters.description: Daily maximum-temperature collection, e.g. tmax_forecast_daily or enacts_tmax_daily.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: The daily interval to calculate as [first date, last date], available in both input collections.

parameters.name: spatial_extent
parameters.description: Area to process, as a west/east/south/north bounding box in EPSG:4326 unless crs is given.

parameters.name: base_temperature
parameters.description: Crop-specific base temperature in degrees Celsius.

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: Registered GDD output dataset: gdd_forecast_daily or gdd_historical_daily.

returns.description: The published daily Growing Degree Days raster cube.
